title: Relay, which builds banking and money management software for small businesses, raised $50M; it previously raised ~$51.5M, including a $32.2M Series B in 2024 (Ryan Lawler/Axios)
summary: Ryan Lawler / Axios: Relay, which builds banking and money management software for small businesses, raised $50M; it previously raised ~$51.5M, including a $32.2M Series B in 2024 — Relay, which builds banking and money management software for small businesses, raised $50 million, CEO Yoseph West tells Axios exclusively.
